notes: Placing of with the genitive autou rather than inside took hold of follows rule 106's oblique-object arm, which names epilambanomai explicitly, the ASV having written took as the compound's own verb word.
s006 takes his under rule 20's second arm; rule 76's own example epebalen ep' auton ten cheira -> laid his hand on him is this very construction.
s013 heads on faith under rule 66's compound clause, pist- being the core and oligo- the modifying element; the supplied O thou is a rule 89 helper on an anarthrous vocative.
eis ti -> wherefore taken as noncompositional under rule 45, as dia ti -> why is.
